page.layout: One page with two parallel columns of words: Basque words on the left, their Latin equivalents on the right, each pair on one printed line. Above the columns, a centred title line "AD MITHRIDATEM". Below the columns, the printed name "j. LIPSIVS" at lower right.
page.notes: The ¶ marks before some Basque words are printed pilcrows. Ieærra is uncertain: the first letter and the vowel after it are hard to read on the scan. Mahatsae is read from a worn final letter. Lætus has a worn ligature in the scan. Nothing else on the page is doubtful.
